findings: New explicit v2 producer streams torch.save through a file-like wrapper. Existing checkpoint save code and closed controllers are unchanged.

Raw, export and temporary weights in a trajectory share one caller-bound allowance. Initial entire-write checks and per-1MiB chunk checks enforce actual free reserve and aggregate capacity before bytes are written.

PyTorch supplies borrowed memoryviews in this runtime. The initial bytes-only implementation failed synthetic tests; corrected buffer support copies at most1MiB per chunk for identical write/digest bytes. Source payload must remain stable during save.

Inherited worker locks and the metadata namespace lock coordinate creation, bounded writes and exclusive publication with resource recorder census. Ten tiny real torch archives interleaved with20 resource samples.

Partial files remain after serialization, IO, reserve, STOP, identity/size/timestamp or publication failure. Existing final or unfinished slot attempts cannot be retried or overwritten. A publication directory-sync failure leaves both names and the census fails closed.

Exact byte limits, raw/export round trips, RNG and optimizer-shaped tensor payloads, mutation/hardlinks, file-count bounds and changing free space were tested. Returned size/SHA covers emitted archive bytes.
limitations: Tiny synthetic tensors are not numerical model optimizer/resume/EMA evidence or wide-model torch.save memory/time feasibility. No corpus, actual MPS, research weights or failed combined fixture were used.

Caller must bind the exact allowance to the frozen plan, hold worker locks, pass the full remaining-campaign storage gate, maintain time/RSS/MPS monitoring, and keep the payload stable during serialization. This component does not authorize dispatch.

Checkpoint serialization itself may allocate memory inside PyTorch; the bounded chunk copy does not establish peak memory. Large-file IO latency under the shared lock remains a measured-pilot concern.

Bounded log/state/cache producers and full v2 controller/stage/cleanup-chain/inference integration remain required, along with actual nine numerical/input reviews and measured pilots. No freeze, training launch or additional research checkpoint deletion occurred.
